Ensure good air circulation in the canopy

Apple___Black_rot.description: A fungal disease that causes leaf spots, fruit rot, and cankers on branches of apple trees.

preventive_measures: Remove dead wood and mummified fruit annually
Maintain tree vigor through proper nutrition
Apple___Black_rot.when_to_contact_expert: Contact an expert if cankers are found on main branches or fruit loss exceeds 10%.
